comment: Minimal smoke graph: input → llm_call with secure_suspend registered as the `ask_secret` tool. Used by Plan 2 Test B integration tests (deterministic via ScriptedAdapter; real via Gemini Flash). The `provider`/`model` fields here are placeholders the test driver overrides.

config.default: Set up a connection — I need username and password to log in.

config.system_message: You collect credentials from the user. When the user asks you to set up any login or connection that needs secrets, call `ask_secret` exactly once with a list of `{question, name}` pairs covering ALL credentials you need. Do not chat about the secrets — just call the tool.

ask_secret.name: ask_secret
ask_secret.description: Ask the user for ONE OR MORE secrets in a SINGLE prompt cycle. Pass `secrets: [{question, name}, ...]` — batch all credentials needed for the same external service in one call. Returns `{handles: {<name>: <sv_<name>>}}`. NEVER ask for secrets via plain chat.
